name: Rice, long duration (Samba / Thaladi / Pishanam)
source: Seasons: TN Agri Dept Crop Production Guide (CPG) Rice: Samba Aug, Thaladi Sep-Oct (Thanjavur); Samba Aug-Sep (Madurai); Pishanam Sep-Oct (Tirunelveli). Water: TNAU eagri AGRO103 lec07, rice 1100-1250 mm (upper end for long duration)

name: Rice, short duration (Kar / Kuruvai / Navarai)
source: Seasons: TN CPG Rice: Early Kar Apr-May & Kar May-Jun (Tirunelveli), Kar May-Jun (Madurai), Kuruvai Jun-Jul (Thanjavur), Navarai Dec-Jan; varieties 105-120 days. Water: TNAU eagri lec07, 1100-1250 mm (lower end)

name: Black gram (urad)
source: Seasons: TN CPG Blackgram: Adipattam Jun-Aug; Puratasipattam Sep-Nov (incl. Madurai, Tirunelveli); Margazhi-Thai Dec-Jan; rice fallows Jan (delta); Chithirai Apr-May (delta). Water: TNAU eagri lec07, pulses 200-450 mm

name: Green gram (moong)
source: Seasons: TN CPG Greengram: Adipattam Jun-Jul; Puratasipattam Sep-Oct (incl. Madurai, Tirunelveli); Margazhi-Thai Dec-Jan; rice fallows Jan. Water: TNAU eagri lec07, pulses 200-450 mm

name: Groundnut
source: Seasons: TN CPG Groundnut, Southern Zone: Thaipattam Jan-Feb (Tirunelveli, irrigated), Margazhi Dec-Jan (Madurai), Aippasi Oct-Nov, Anipattam Jun-Jul (rainfed); varieties 100-110 days. Water: TNAU eagri lec07, 500-550 mm

name: Sesame (gingelly)
source: Seasons: TN CPG Sesame, Southern Zone: Chithirai Apr-May (Tirunelveli, irrigated), Karthigai Nov-Dec (Tirunelveli, rainfed), Anipattam Jun-Jul (Madurai), Margazhi Dec-Jan; Masi Feb-Mar; 75-85 days. Water: approximate (no TN figure found)

name: Pearl millet
source: Seasons: TN CPG Cumbu, Southern Zone (Madurai, Tirunelveli): Thai Jan-Feb, Chithirai Apr-May, Puratasi Sep-Oct; CO 9/CO 10 75-90 days. Water: approximate, similar to ragi 350 mm (TNAU eagri lec07)

name: Finger millet (ragi)
source: Seasons: TN CPG Ragi, Southern Zone: Madurai Dec-Jan, Apr-May, Sep-Oct; Tirunelveli Sep-Oct; varieties 105-125 days. Water: TNAU eagri lec07, 350 mm

name: Foxtail millet (thinai)
source: Seasons and duration: TN CPG Small Millets (02_Small_Millets.pdf), all zones incl. Southern: Masi Feb-Mar, Adi Jun-Jul, Purattasi Sep-Oct; CO (Te) 7 80-85 days. Water: approximate (small millets ~250-350 mm; not in the guide)

name: Little millet (samai)
source: Seasons and duration: TN CPG Small Millets, Masi / Adi / Purattasi pattams; ATL 1, CO (Samai) 4, Paiyur 2 75-90 days. Water: approximate

name: Kodo millet (varagu)
source: Seasons and duration: TN CPG Small Millets, Masi / Adi / Purattasi pattams; CO 3 120 days, TNAU 86 105-110 days. Water: approximate

name: Proso millet (panivaragu)
source: Seasons and duration: TN CPG Small Millets, Masi / Adi / Purattasi pattams; CO (Pv) 5, TNAU 202 70-75 days. Water: approximate

name: Barnyard millet (kuthiraivali)
source: Seasons and duration: TN CPG Small Millets, Masi / Adi / Purattasi pattams; CO (Kv) 2, MDU 1 95-100 days. Water: approximate; tolerates brief waterlogging better than other small millets

name: Sorghum
source: Seasons: TN CPG Sorghum, Southern Zone (Madurai, Tirunelveli): Thai Jan-Feb, Chithirai Apr-May, Puratasi Sep-Oct; K 12 / CO 30 95-105 days. Water: TNAU eagri lec07, 350-500 mm

name: Maize
source: Seasons: TN CPG Maize, Southern Zone: Madurai Jan-Feb, Jun-Jul, Sep-Oct; Tirunelveli Sep-Oct; hybrids ~110 days. Water: TNAU eagri lec07, 500-600 mm

name: Cotton
source: Seasons: TN CPG Cotton: winter irrigated Aug-Sep and summer irrigated Feb-Mar (Madurai, Tirunelveli), rainfed Sep-Oct (Madurai). Water: TNAU eagri lec07, 550-600 mm. Duration approximate

name: Sugarcane
source: Seasons: TN CPG Sugarcane: main season planting Dec-Jan (early), Feb-Mar (mid), Apr-May (late); ~11-12 months. Water: TNAU eagri lec07, 1800-2200 mm. Price: FRP (not MSP)

name: Banana
source: approximate (horticulture crop; not in the field-crops guide); major Tirunelveli / Thoothukudi crop; verify locally

name: Cowpea
source: Seasons: TN CPG Cowpea: Adipattam Jun-Aug; Purattasi Sep-Nov (Madurai); Margazhi-Thai Dec-Feb (Madurai, Tirunelveli); 70-80 days. Water: TNAU eagri lec07, pulses 200-450 mm

name: Daincha (Sesbania) green manure
source: approximate; TN CPG lists Daincha as green manure ploughed in before rice (no season table); verify locally

name: Sunnhemp green manure
source: approximate; TN CPG lists Sunnhemp as green manure (no season table); verify locally
